description: The web app's Core Web Vitals from real browsers: a 0 to 100 performance score (LCP 30%, INP 30%, CLS 15%, FCP 15%, TTFB 10%, Google's thresholds), each vital's p75 with its good / needs improvement / poor counts, and pages ranked by opportunity (how much the score would rise if that page scored 100).

environment.description: Like production. Default: production when the app has it, else its busiest non-development one. 'all' for every environment.

from.description: An ISO time, or how long ago: 30m, 24h, 7d

range.description: Window: 1h, 24h, 7d, 14d, 30d or 90d (default 24h). Ignored when from is given.

service.description: Only this service, like house-ai-api or the app's bundle id

source.description: backend (servers), frontend (app and web), or all (default)

to.description: An ISO time, or how long ago (default now)

name: get_web_vitals
title: Web vitals
